opportunityDefinitions.vpip: Hand/player with voluntary preflop call/raise / hand/player with at least one voluntary decision
opportunityDefinitions.pfr: Hand/player raising preflop / hand/player with a legal preflop raise opportunity
opportunityDefinitions.rfi: Raise before any voluntary action / priced unopened decision with legal raising; excludes BB free option
opportunityDefinitions.limp: Call before any voluntary action / priced unopened decision
opportunityDefinitions.overlimp: Call behind limper / priced unraised decision after voluntary call
opportunityDefinitions.isolation: Raise over limper(s) / unraised decision after voluntary call with legal raising
opportunityDefinitions.coldCall: Call with no prior voluntary contribution, nonblind seat / priced first response to one open
opportunityDefinitions.threeBet: Raise after one raise / first legal re-raise opportunity facing exactly one raise
opportunityDefinitions.fourBet: Raise after two raises / first legal re-raise opportunity facing exactly two raises
opportunityDefinitions.squeeze: Raise after open and cold call / legal re-raise opportunity after open and cold call
opportunityDefinitions.foldToThreeBet: Fold / opener first priced response after second preflop raise
opportunityDefinitions.blindDefense: Call or raise / SB or BB first priced response to open
opportunityDefinitions.flopCbet: Bet / last preflop raiser first legal unopened-flop opportunity
opportunityDefinitions.turnBarrel: Bet turn / previous flop aggressor first legal unopened-turn opportunity
opportunityDefinitions.riverBarrel: Bet river / previous turn aggressor first legal unopened-river opportunity
opportunityDefinitions.checkRaise: Raise after checking / first later legal raise opportunity facing price on same street
opportunityDefinitions.foldToCbet: Fold / first response to a true flop cbet
opportunityDefinitions.drawCall: Call / visible private-contribution draw facing price before river
opportunityDefinitions.drawRaise: Raise / private-contribution draw with legal raising before river
opportunityDefinitions.valueBet: Bet/raise / legal raising opportunity with operational private two-pair+ or top-pair value proxy
opportunityDefinitions.airBet: Bet/raise / legal raising opportunity with unpaired no-live-draw proxy (not true bluff intention)
opportunityDefinitions.riverBluffCatch: Call / river priced decision with one private pair proxy
opportunityDefinitions.foldSmall: Fold / facing last postflop bet or raise increment ≤25% of pot after the raiser called, frozen at that raise event
opportunityDefinitions.continueOverbet: Call/raise / facing last postflop bet or raise increment ≥150% of pot after the raiser called, frozen at that raise event
opportunityDefinitions.WTSD: Reached showdown / saw flop while eligible (includes all-in runouts)
opportunityDefinitions.WSD: Positive pot award / showdown participant; ties count as awards
opportunityDefinitions.WWSF: Positive pot award / saw flop while eligible
